title: ComplianceMesh Autonomous Web Application Security Testing Guide
description: Production-grade declarative test specification aligned to OWASP WSTG v4.2, OWASP ASVS v5, NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, and NIST SP 800-63B. Each test step maps directly to a regulatory control ID for automated compliance traceability.

metadata.author: ComplianceMesh Security Automation Engine
frameworks_covered: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG) v4.2
OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) v5.0

steps.description: Navigate to application root and capture initial response fingerprint (server headers, technology stack disclosure).
Detect technology stack disclosure via Server, X-Powered-By, X-AspNet-Version, or X-Generator headers.
Check robots.txt for sensitive endpoint disclosure (e.g. /admin, /backup, /api/internal).
Check for RFC 9116 security.txt at /.well-known/security.txt for responsible disclosure policy.
Audit HTML meta tags for framework/version disclosure or sensitive content in meta name='generator'.
Verify HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header presence and max-age directive to prevent SSL stripping attacks.
Verify Content Security Policy (CSP) header presence to mitigate XSS and data injection attacks.
Verify X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header to prevent MIME type sniffing attacks.
Audit Referrer-Policy header to prevent sensitive URL path leakage to third-party domains.
Verify Permissions-Policy (formerly Feature-Policy) to restrict access to browser APIs (camera, microphone, geolocation).
Audit Access-Control-Allow-Origin for wildcard (*) or overly permissive CORS configuration.
Probe custom error page handling. Verify no stack traces, debug info, or framework internals are leaked.
Probe null byte injection handling in URL path to test input sanitization at the server level.

test_suites.framework: OWASP WSTG v4.2 / ASVS v5 / NIST SP 800-63B
test_suites.name: Authentication Mechanism & Credential Security Audit

steps.description: Navigate to root and observe authentication redirection behavior. Verify secure redirect to login page over HTTPS.
Verify password input fields use type='password' for masking. Check autocomplete='off' or 'new-password' attributes.
Audit login/registration forms for secure submission (POST method, HTTPS action URL, CSRF token presence).
Probe authentication API endpoint to verify it rejects unauthenticated GET requests with proper 401/403 status.
Attempt direct access to administrative panel without valid session. Expect 401/403 or redirect to login.
Audit all cookies for Secure flag (HTTPS-only transmission) to prevent session hijacking over unencrypted connections.
Audit all cookies for HttpOnly flag to prevent client-side JavaScript access and XSS-based session theft.
Audit all cookies for SameSite attribute (Strict or Lax) to mitigate CSRF attacks via cross-origin cookie submission.
Audit HTML5 LocalStorage for session tokens, JWTs, or authentication credentials stored in plaintext.
Audit HTML5 SessionStorage for sensitive authentication or session management data.
Attempt horizontal privilege escalation by accessing admin resources without admin-level authorization.
Probe user enumeration API endpoint. Verify proper authorization enforcement returns 401/403 for unauthenticated requests.
Probe for exposed environment variable files (.env) containing API keys or database credentials.
Probe internal configuration API endpoint. Verify it is not publicly accessible without authentication.

test_suites.name: DOM Injection, XSS & Input Sanitization Audit

steps.selector: input[type='text'], input:not([type]), textarea, input[type='search'], input[type='email'], input[type='url']
steps.description: Enumerate all user-facing text input fields for DOM injection surface analysis.
Enumerate hidden form inputs that may contain CSRF tokens, user IDs, or server-side state parameters.
Detect forms submitting over insecure HTTP (non-HTTPS) connections exposing user data in transit.

test_suites.name: Error Response & Stack Trace Leakage Audit

steps.description: Verify custom 404 error page does not leak server stack traces, framework versions, or internal file paths.
Probe for unhandled server exception pages. Verify no debug mode stack traces or database connection strings are exposed.
Capture browser console errors to identify client-side JavaScript exceptions or failed resource loading.
Verify X-Frame-Options header (DENY or SAMEORIGIN) to prevent clickjacking attacks.
Verify Content-Security-Policy includes script-src, object-src, and base-uri directives to block inline XSS.
Final deep audit of HTML5 Web Storage for any unencrypted sensitive data (tokens, PII, passwords).
Audit SessionStorage for sensitive transient data that may persist during browser tab lifetime.

test_suites.name: NIST Access Control & Audit Logging Verification

steps.description: Verify health check endpoint accessibility boundaries. Public health endpoints must not expose internal system state.
NIST SC-8 Transmission Confidentiality: Verify HSTS enforcement for data-in-transit protection.
NIST IA-11 Re-Authentication: Verify session cookies enforce proper expiration and re-authentication boundaries.
